limitations: Natasha LOC extraction is optimized for Russian news text rather than arbitrary postal-address strings.
SOIKA rules-v3 is the precision-first extractor for explicit and bounded short free-form house addresses; Natasha remains a fallback for location mentions.
A recognized house request must not be silently downgraded to a street-only successful result.
Only object levels listed in the qualified validation manifest may be treated as production-approved.
